chains.name: Uranium & nuclear fuel cycle
chains.thesis: Reactor restarts, life extensions, new builds and datacenter-driven nuclear PPAs collide with a decade of mine under-investment; the term-contracting cycle reprices the whole fuel chain — miners, converters, enrichers, fuel services — years before spot moves show it.

commodity.spot_source: web-cited (UxC/Numerco via press) or SRUUF/U.UN trust NAV proxy — uranium spot is NOT an FMP commodity

chains.notes: The one chain where the contracting cycle (term vs spot) is the regime tell. UROY is the royalty pure-play (business_model=royalty_streamer, auto-passes cash gates). Restart/greenfield developers (NXE, DNN-class) are lane_b via dated milestones (permits, FID, first drum).

chains.name: Copper & electrification metals
chains.thesis: Grid build-out, datacenters, EVs and reshored manufacturing add structural copper demand into a thin project pipeline — new mines take 10+ years from discovery to first cathode; the cost curve reprices producers long before the deficit closes.
chains.notes: 'Copper' and 'Aluminum' industry strings are (verify) — confirm against /stable/available-industries on the first live run; 'Other Industrial Metals & Mining' is proven in themes_map.py. Diversified miners (TECK-class) need commodity_revenue_share from the chain map, not 1.0.

chains.name: Rare earths & strategic metals
chains.thesis: Export controls turned rare earths, antimony, gallium and tungsten from commodities into strategic chokepoints; Western governments now act as forced buyers (price floors, DoD/DOE awards, stockpiles), repricing every ex-China ounce on policy datelines rather than spot.

commodity.spot_source: web-cited (Shanghai Metals Market NdPr via press) — NdPr is NOT an FMP commodity

chains.notes: The policy chain: most catalysts are government datelines, not price. 'Other Precious Metals & Mining' and 'Specialty Chemicals' are (verify) — Specialty Chemicals is included ONLY to catch processors/separators FMP files there; the chain map must drop actual chemical companies (chain_fit_confidence=low). UUUU carries uranium_fuel_cycle AND this chain (counts toward both caps).

chains.name: Power for AI
chains.thesis: Datacenter load growth outruns grid interconnection; whoever can deliver firm electrons or the equipment to make them — turbines, transformers, switchgear, nuclear-levered IPPs, grid EPC — sells into a queue measured in years.

commodity.spot_source: FMP commodities (Henry Hub front month) — the fuel-cost driver for IPP spark spreads, not a revenue driver

chains.notes: Inherited the energy_transition ground from the retired Disruptor Lens (GEV/ETN/CEG-class). SMR developers (OKLO/SMR-class, pre-revenue) are lane_b via NRC/COL datelines, never lane_a. This chain's torque metric is margin-vs-power-prices, not margin-vs-metal.

chains.name: Robotics & physical AI
chains.thesis: Labor scarcity + reshoring push factories, warehouses and surgery toward robots, and the humanoid ramp adds a new demand curve on top; the motion-control, vision, actuator and surgical-platform toll-takers monetize every deployment wave — and every robot is magnets, motors and copper windings (the demand side of this basket's metal chains).

commodity.spot_source: no commodity — the regime read is the industrial-capex cycle + humanoid program datelines; deterministic metrics use the non-commodity set (gm_trajectory/backlog), never torque

chains.notes: MIGRATED from the retired Disruptor Lens taxonomy (industry strings proven in its live runs). Industrial names here are demand-cycle cyclicals — the chain map must separate secular penetration from a capex bounce. Pre-FCF humanoid/robotics developers are lane_b via dated milestones (named production contracts, first customer deployments), never lane_a.

chains.name: Quantum computing & sensing
chains.thesis: Government programs and early enterprise contracts fund the quantum stack years before commercial breakeven; awards, named contracts and error-correction milestones are dated, idiosyncratic events that reprice names regardless of when quantum advantage actually arrives — and the cryo/photonics/control toll-takers get paid on every lab and testbed build-out either way.

commodity.spot_source: no commodity — the regime read is the government funding cycle (NQI reauthorization, DARPA/DOE programs, sovereign initiatives) + the error-correction milestone track; non-commodity metric set applies

chains.notes: The broadest industry filters in the taxonomy — this chain leans hardest on keyword hints + the chain map's physical-anchor rule; expect a high drop rate (generic hardware/semis names map low-confidence and are dropped WITH printed symbols). Pure-play platforms (IONQ/RGTI/QBTS-class) are pre-FCF -> lane_b via dated milestones (signed government awards, named enterprise/defense contracts, dated error-correction demos); an honestly tiny lane_a (FORM/COHR-class toll-takers) is the expected outcome, not a failure.

vocab_note: industry strings verified 2026-07-08 against /stable/profile anchors (MP, GEV, VST, ROK, KEYS, ALB, ISRG) — the stable API vocabulary differs from the legacy screener strings the 1.1 (verify) list guessed ('Other Industrial Metals & Mining'->'Industrial Materials', 'Specialty Chemicals'->'Chemicals - Specialty', 'Utilities - Independent Power Producers'->'Independent Power Producers', 'Specialty Industrial Machinery'->'Industrial - Machinery', 'Scientific & Technical Instruments'->'Hardware, Equipment & Parts'; GEV lives in 'Renewable Utilities'; ISRG in 'Medical - Devices')
